Title: Azure Private Link for Azure Batch is now generally available in select regions

Body.Content:
Azure Private Link for Azure Batch is now generally available in the West US 2, East US, South Central US, US Gov Virginia, and US Gov Arizona regions.

Get started with quickstarts and tutorials for using private endpoints with Azure Batch accounts.

Learn more about connecting to a Private Link resource through a private endpoint.
